name: LotKeys Facebook Posting Buddy
notes: Existing Facebook Listing photo updates replace the complete photo set in the saved LotKeys order instead of appending duplicates.
Posting Buddy loads all replacement photos before removing the live Facebook set; unsafe removal leaves the existing photos unchanged for manual review.
Selected Model, Mileage, Price and Description values are cleared before replacement on updates.
Retains V0.1.21 chunked large-video transfer and speed-first new-post/update option defaults.
